16 October 2026LATEST

YOUR LEARNING SPACE, REFINED

More focus. More clarity.

One day at a time

Day 1 is ready to start. Mark a day complete in Lesson tools to unlock the next. Finished lessons stay available for review, and your saved records are kept. The same order applies to vocabulary practice and offline learning.

Clearer Chinese meanings

Vocabulary meanings now use larger, darker text with more space between lines, across lessons, the word studio and your collection.

English throughout

Navigation, instructions, grammar explanations, answer feedback, learning notes and download messages are in English. Chinese is kept only for vocabulary meanings.

Simpler answer checking

Choice questions check your answer as soon as you select an option. Typed questions keep the Check answer button. Open Answer help when you want an answer or explanation.

Focused daily lessons

All 30 lessons share the dashboard’s responsive design. Find goals, completion, course switching and parent notes under Lesson tools. Sources and downloads open on demand. Desktop lessons stay in place as you turn questions, preserving your position in shared passages. Long content scrolls within the practice sheet without visible scrollbars; phones keep natural page scrolling.

Smoother audio controls

Recordings sit beside the lesson title, with no extra hint below. The player stays in place as you turn questions, avoiding a flashing line and keeping your place in the same recording.

A dashboard that helps you get started

Continue your next lesson, see your 30-day progress or practise a short vocabulary round. Save words for later in the same searchable collection used throughout the course.

✓

Your existing lesson progress, word marks and downloaded audio are kept. Everything you have saved remains available offline.

15 October 2026
✓

THE EVERYDAY DETAILS

Smoother practice, wherever you are.

A personal word collection

Save unfamiliar words from any lesson. Search words or meanings, filter by learning day, return to the original word card and remove marks when you are ready.

Choice labels that match the answers

Options follow their displayed order: A, B, C and beyond. Your selection, feedback and answer explanation stay in sync.

More reliable offline updates

Downloads verify files before saving and resume from where they stopped. Missing local files no longer block course updates. A new-version notice lets you choose when to refresh, keeping your saved records and audio.
